id: title:Gilbert09:stop fanning out project resources over archived projects

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion: OpenAI connector no longer requests archived projects, preventing schema failure and unnecessary API calls.
review.reason: The change removes archived project enumeration and pagination parameters from the OpenAI warehouse connector. This prevents unnecessary API calls and potential schema mismatches when querying archived projects, which are no longer requested. The implementation and corresponding test updates are visible, supporting a tier 2 assessment.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of excluding archived projects depends on whether archived projects are still relevant for warehouse ingestion or if this change could inadvertently exclude needed historical data. The code does not independently verify that archived projects are irrelevant, only that the connector no longer requests them.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Archived projects are excluded from the OpenAI resource enumeration; archived projects are no longer requested. The archived-project exclusion is also removed from the test assertion.
observations.code_quote: # Project-scoped resources have no org-wide list endpoint; enumerate the projects and fetch
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: OpenAI connector no longer requests archived projects, preventing schema failure and unnecessary API calls.

observations.behavior: The explicit 'limit' parameter is removed from the OpenAI projects endpoint configuration; archived projects are no longer requested.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: The connector no longer paginates archived projects, reducing unnecessary API calls.

observations.behavior: The test assertion checking for 'include_archived' is removed; archived projects are no longer requested.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: Tests no longer expect archived projects to be requested, aligning with the connector behavior.
